note: “Wish me partaker” is an instruction to Valentine; “Wish I could share” reads as Proteus’s own wish
leftover archaism “Ay” (no pun depends on it)
“his friendly wish” is Valentine’s wish; “his friend’s wish” shifts the referent
“None else would” misrendered as others showing the signs; it means nobody else would notice them.
Drops “stand” in “stand affected”, which Speed’s next bawdy reply (“stop standing up”) depends on.
Garbled phrasing: “wind it onto a spool on me” for “bottom it on me”.
Invented motive: original says only that he did not hear, not that he pretended.
Comparison garbled: says he cares as little as he wishes her good fortune; original means he cares little for himself and wishes her every good.
“more mischances” means additional misfortunes, not worse ones.
“forced your love” means compel her to love him, not “stolen your love”.
